name: NULL_EQ_NULL_IS_NULL
description: NULL = NULL evaluates to NULL (three-valued logic)
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT NULL = NULL;

name: NULL_NEQ_NULL_IS_NULL
description: NULL <> NULL evaluates to NULL
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT NULL <> NULL;

name: NULL_LT_NUMBER_IS_NULL
description: NULL < 1 evaluates to NULL on both sides
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT NULL < 1, 1 < NULL;

name: NULL_PLUS_INT_IS_NULL
description: NULL arithmetic propagates NULL
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT NULL + 1, 1 + NULL, NULL * 0;

name: NULL_CONCAT_TEXT_IS_NULL
description: NULL || 'x' is NULL (SQLite-specific; differs from PG)
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT NULL || 'x', 'x' || NULL;

name: IS_NULL_DEFINITE_BOOL
description: IS NULL / IS NOT NULL return definite booleans
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT NULL IS NULL, 1 IS NULL, NULL IS NOT NULL, 1 IS NOT NULL;

name: IS_DISTINCT_FROM_BASIC
description: IS DISTINCT FROM treats NULLs as not-distinct
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT NULL IS DISTINCT FROM NULL, 1 IS DISTINCT FROM NULL, 1 IS DISTINCT FROM 1, 1 IS DISTINCT FROM 2;

name: IS_NOT_DISTINCT_FROM_BASIC
description: IS NOT DISTINCT FROM returns 1 for two NULLs
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT NULL IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NULL, 1 IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NULL, 1 IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 1, 1 IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 2;

name: NULL_AND_FALSE_SHORTCIRCUIT
description: NULL AND 0 short-circuits to 0; NULL AND 1 stays NULL
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT NULL AND 0, NULL AND 1, 0 AND NULL, 1 AND NULL;

name: NULL_OR_TRUE_SHORTCIRCUIT
description: NULL OR 1 short-circuits to 1; NULL OR 0 stays NULL
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT NULL OR 1, NULL OR 0, 1 OR NULL, 0 OR NULL;

name: NOT_NULL_IS_NULL
description: NOT NULL is NULL (three-valued)
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT NOT NULL;

name: NULL_IN_LIST
description: NULL IN (...) and value IN (NULL,...) semantics
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT NULL IN (1,2,3), 1 IN (NULL, 1), 1 IN (NULL, 2), 1 NOT IN (NULL, 2);

name: NULL_BETWEEN
description: NULL BETWEEN ... evaluates to NULL on any NULL bound
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT NULL BETWEEN 0 AND 5, 3 BETWEEN NULL AND 5, 3 BETWEEN 0 AND NULL;

name: NULL_LIKE_PATTERN
description: NULL LIKE pattern is NULL; pattern LIKE NULL is NULL
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT NULL LIKE 'a%', 'abc' LIKE NULL, NULL LIKE NULL;

name: COALESCE_PICKS_FIRST_NON_NULL
description: COALESCE returns first non-NULL argument
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT COALESCE(NULL, NULL, 3, 4), COALESCE(NULL, NULL, NULL);

name: IFNULL_TWO_ARG
description: IFNULL is a 2-arg COALESCE alias
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT IFNULL(NULL, 'fallback'), IFNULL(1, 'fallback');

name: NULLIF_BASIC
description: NULLIF returns NULL when args equal, else first arg
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT NULLIF(1, 1), NULLIF(1, 2), NULLIF(NULL, 1), NULLIF(1, NULL);

name: IIF_NULL_CONDITION
description: IIF: NULL condition selects else branch
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT IIF(NULL, 'then', 'else'), IIF(0, 'then', 'else'), IIF(1, 'then', 'else');

name: CASE_WHEN_NULL_MATCH
description: CASE WHEN col = NULL never matches; use IS NULL instead
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
WITH v(x) AS (VALUES (NULL),(1),(2))
SELECT x, CASE WHEN x = NULL THEN 'eq-null' WHEN x IS NULL THEN 'is-null' ELSE 'other' END FROM v;

name: EXISTS_WITH_NULL_ROWS
description: EXISTS returns 1 even when matched row has only NULL columns

name: TYPEOF_NULL
description: typeof(NULL) returns 'null' even after CAST
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT typeof(NULL), typeof(CAST(NULL AS INTEGER));

name: UNIQUE_ALLOWS_MULTIPLE_NULLS
description: SQLite UNIQUE indexes allow multiple NULLs (deviation from strict SQL)

name: NOT_NULL_DEFAULT_ACCEPTED
description: NOT NULL column with DEFAULT accepts implicit default and explicit value

name: NULL_LITERAL_VS_QUOTED_STRING
description: NULL keyword vs 'NULL' string literal differ via typeof
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT NULL, 'NULL', typeof(NULL), typeof('NULL');

name: NULL_GLOB_PATTERN
description: NULL GLOB pattern propagates NULL just like LIKE
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT NULL GLOB 'a*', 'abc' GLOB NULL;
